turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Sure. I'll solve one first and explain each step.
"He is ___ engineer." I look at "engineer". It starts with the sound "e", a vowel sound. So the answer is an: He is an engineer.
The rule in one line: an before a vowel sound, a before every other sound.
Right: It is a lamp. Wrong: It is an lamp.

Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
